title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna price cut 80%
summary: OpenAI announced an 80% price reduction for GPT-5.6 Luna, its fastest and most affordable model, alongside 15% efficiency gains from kernel optimizations and experiments. This drastic cost reduction reshapes AI model economics, making high-quality inference accessible at a fraction of previous cost, and signals a new era of falling prices after a year of increases. The 80% cut means Luna is now 5x cheaper, achieved through kernel work reducing serving cost by 20% and token-generation efficiency gains over 15%. This applies to both API and consumer usage.
context: GPT-5.6 is a family of models from OpenAI released in July 2026, with three variants: Luna \(cheapest\), Terra \(balanced\), and Sol \(flagship\). Luna was already very capable and affordable; this update further slashes costs dramatically.
discussion: The community expressed shock and excitement, with comments noting the transition feels like dial-up to broadband and speculation about billions in monthly savings for inference providers. Some highlighted the difficulty of choosing models optimally.
